section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces Study 2, which aims to provide a stronger test of the learning agenda framework by measuring goals and learning strategies early in the semester, including utility value as a mediator, and testing the impact of goals and strategies on students' exam performance. It outlines several hypotheses regarding MAP and PAP goals, their prediction of learning strategies, utility value, and academic achievement, including a moderated mediation hypothesis for vigilance and instructional importance judgments.
